pool.note: Keyed by institution name (guaranteed). keyDeclares: institution kinds are exactly the INSTITUTION_KIND_PATTERNS regex hits on the key (so "Ale house", "Priest (resident)", "Sawmill", "Airship docking" declare no kind); market/guild/crime/defence/water keys by name; magic on arcane keys assumes the magicLicense filter (domain/magicFilter.js) keeps them out of magic-off worlds (Druid Circle, Elder Grove Council, Alchemist quarter are licensed none, so their magic lines declare it). Rows gated in code are not declared: Fishmonger|Fresh fish and Fish market|Fresh fish retail (inlandAlternative on waterAccess none), Dragon resident|Aerial deterrence (magical:true). Not expressible: setting-specific faith (Woodcarver|Religious carvings "Crucifixes... saints"), an overlord ("lord's court", "the lord's dues", Village reeve/Lord's appointee "on behalf of the lord"), graveyard presumed by Access to parish church|Last rites, "sold at market" (Subsistence farming, market may be elsewhere: not declared). Tailor's Guild "city watch livery" also reaches towns (declared watch only). Season (no atom): Fisher's Landing|Salted fish, Butchers|Salting (winter); Beekeeper/Brewer/Shepherd/Hunter seasonal. Non-declaring rows are colour:false: they state the keyed institution's own function, not colour. Designer numbers/rules printed as fact: Local fence|Sell stolen goods ("20-40% of value"), Enchanter|Weapon enchantment ("+1 quality"), Elder Grove Council|High-level nature magic (spell names); keys print numbers too (Cathedral (10,000+ only), Merchant guilds (3-8), Healer (divine, 1st level), Spellcasting services (1st-6th) is a service name).
